fdroid:SVS.pdfinspector.name: PDF Inspector
fdroid:SVS.pdfinspector.summary: Inspect, select, edit and delete the elements inside any PDF
fdroid:SVS.pdfinspector.description:
PDF Inspector opens a PDF and shows what is actually inside it. Like a browser's developer tools, it parses each page's content stream into a navigable tree of elements (text blocks, vector paths and images) so you can find any single element, select it on the page or in the tree, and edit it. Edits go to a saved copy; your original file is never touched.
Highlights:
* DevTools-style element tree: every page is parsed into a structured tree of text, path and image nodes, grouped the way the PDF draws them. Switch between friendly labels and the raw content-stream operators.
* Two-way selection: tap an element on the page or tap its row in the tree, and the other side highlights to match, with a clear bordered outline on the canvas.
* Edit in place: move and resize an element, recolor its fill or stroke (entered as hex, with the element's color space shown), and retype text. When the original font lacks a character, re-encode the line with a fallback font, bundled or taken from your device or imported. Changes are written straight back into the content stream, with full undo and redo.
* Surgical delete: remove exactly the element you picked by rewriting just its part of the content stream, leaving the rest of the page untouched.
* Save a copy: write your edited PDF to a new file through the system file picker; the source document is left unchanged.
* Smooth viewing: pan and pinch-zoom, fit to width or height, a global zoom that carries across pages, and a full-screen mode.
* Dockable inspector: the inspector panel docks to the side in landscape or the bottom in portrait, can be resized, and can be made transparent to see the page through it.
* Material You: Material 3 design with dynamic color on Android 12+, light / dark / system themes and a choice of accent colors.
Private and open:
* Open source, no accounts, no telemetry.
* No network access and no storage permission: files are opened and saved through Android's Storage Access Framework, so the app only ever touches the documents you explicitly pick.
PDF Inspector works with the drawing primitives a PDF already contains: select, move, resize, recolor, retype and delete them. It is not a word-processor-style text editor, so lines do not reflow, but when the original font is missing a character you can re-encode the text with a fallback font, bundled or taken from your device or imported.

Browse all 118 elements with category filters, shell diagrams, physical properties, and spectra. Interactive heatmaps display trends for electronegativity, atomic radius, ionization energy, density, melting point, and boiling point (in K, °C, or °F) with top-five rankings.

• Dilution Calculator
• Ideal Gas Law
• SMILES Visualizer
• 3D Molecule Viewer

fdroid:io.github.sloppytopp.n0rma.name: N0RMA
fdroid:io.github.sloppytopp.n0rma.summary: Spot trackers, drones and camera-like Wi-Fi. Nothing leaves your phone.
fdroid:io.github.sloppytopp.n0rma.description:
N0RMA helps you check whether anything nearby is tracking or watching you - using only your phone's own Bluetooth and Wi-Fi radios. No account, no cloud, no ads, no analytics. It cannot even connect to the internet.
WHAT IT DOES
- Finds Bluetooth trackers that are separated from their owner (Apple Find My / AirTag-style, Tile, Samsung SmartTag, Chipolo) and ignores normal "owner nearby" signals
- Listens for FAA Remote ID drone broadcasts over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, worded honestly as claims (Remote ID can be faked)
- Flags camera-like and drone-like Wi-Fi networks
- Tells you in plain words: "All clear", "Keeping an eye on something" or "Needs your attention" - with live proof it is working
- Tap-to-find: tap an alert for a hot/cold meter, warmer/colder arrow, a real compass sweep, and a GPS+compass arrow for drones that broadcast a position
- Room sweeps: build a baseline per room, spot what is NEW, and see which room a device is probably in
- Survey walks: log what you hear while you walk, see rough source positions, and save a KML (Google Earth) or WiGLE-format file - saved locally, nothing uploads
- "This is mine" for your own trackers and camera-like sources so they stop flagging
- Smart devices: nearby gadgets grouped by maker, plus a privacy checklist (Amazon Sidewalk, Ring/Alexa accounts, router)
- Physical-inspection checklist per room, and a camera-lens finder that uses the torch to spot lens glints in a dark room
- Sweep report: which rooms you swept and inspected, what was NOT checked, and what was flagged - it never says a place is "clear"
- Dark, low-glare screens and a dim-red night mode, so searching at night does not light up the street
- Discreet mode: neutral notifications hidden on the lock screen, PIN lock, hidden from recents and screenshots, a Notes/Weather disguise, one-tap quick exit
- "Try it with sample data" shows every screen working before you trust it with anything real
HONEST LIMITS
A quiet screen is NOT a guarantee of safety. A phone cannot see drones without Remote ID, cameras that only record to an SD card, cellular/GPS trackers, or most hidden devices. Signal-strength distance and direction are rough estimates, and walls bend them. Android limits how often Wi-Fi can be scanned and needs the Location switch on (N0RMA does not read, save or send your location). Some phones stop background apps to save battery.
PRIVACY
Everything stays on the phone. There is no internet permission. The camera permission is used only by the Lens finder, only while it is open: pictures are analysed in memory and thrown away, never saved or sent. History is deleted after 30 days, and you can delete everything with one tap. Drone operator positions are shown live and never saved. The optional address search for your home uses Android's own lookup service; GPS and typed coordinates send nothing.
SAFETY
If you find something you do not own, leave it where it is, photograph it, and contact local law enforcement. Never shoot at, jam or interfere with a drone. If you feel unsafe (for example because of a stalker or abusive partner), contact local police or a hotline; in the US, the National Domestic Violence Hotline is 1-800-799-7233.
Detect-only: N0RMA never jams, spoofs or transmits. Free and open source (MIT).

REAL-TIME SATELLITE DATA
Live fire detection from NASA FIRMS (Fire Information for Resource Management System)
VIIRS sensors on NOAA-20 and Suomi-NPP satellites
Updates within 3 hours of satellite observation
Color-coded fire intensity indicators (Low, Moderate, High, Extreme)
PORTUGUESE CIVIL PROTECTION
Live fire data from Proteção Civil via Fogos.pt
Per-incident detail: firefighters, vehicles, aircraft deployed
Fire status tracking from first alert to resolution
Resource-history charts showing response progression
Automatically activates when you're in Portugal
PAN-EUROPEAN PUSH ALERTS
Server-driven push notifications anywhere in Europe — no need to keep the app running
Inside Portugal: alerts powered by the ANEPC / ProCiv official feed
Elsewhere in Europe: alerts powered by Copernicus EFFIS
Country name and source attribution in every push
Configurable alert radius (5–200 km), defaults to 15 km
Persistence guard: a satellite detection must be confirmed across two consecutive polls before a push is sent — fewer false positives
CITIZEN REPORTS
Spotted a fire on the ground? Tap "Report fire" and submit a report with optional photo
Six fire-specific categories: Wildfire, Building, Vehicle, Industrial, Agricultural, Other
Reports are visible to ProCiv operators and to other Fire users on the map
Sign in privately with Apple or Google — no password to remember
Build trust over time: 10-tier reputation ladder from Civilian to Mythic, earned by submitting accurate reports
FIRE SPREAD FORECAST
Predict how fires may spread using a scientific elliptical fire spread model
Based on Anderson (1983) and Alexander (1985) wildfire research
Real-time wind, humidity and soil-moisture data from Open-Meteo
Time-stepped predictions at 1, 3 and 6 hours
LIVE WIND MAP
Wind direction and speed overlay across the visible map
Color-coded arrows from blue (calm) to red (strong wind)
Auto-refreshes as you pan and zoom
Powered by Open-Meteo real-time weather data
INTERACTIVE MAP
Standard, satellite and NASA VIIRS imagery views
See smoke plumes and burn scars on true-color satellite imagery
Fire Weather Index overlay from Copernicus EFFIS — the official 6-class danger scale
Burnt-area overlay highlighting recently-burnt terrain
IPMA daily fire-risk map (Portugal)
Built-in legend in Settings explains every map control
STATISTICS
Country picker auto-presets to your location
Active fires breakdown by country (FIRMS, Europe-wide)
Detailed Portugal stats: severity, deployed resources, resources over time, fire types, status, top districts
Intensity distribution and satellite-detection analytics
PRIVACY FIRST
No account required to view fires or receive alerts
Sign-in is optional and only needed to submit citizen reports
Your location only leaves the device when push alerts are enabled (so the server knows what radius to match)
No third-party tracking or analytics
NINE-LANGUAGE SUPPORT
Available in English, German, Portuguese, Spanish, French, Italian, Greek, Arabic and Serbian.
DATA SOURCES
Fire data provided by NASA FIRMS, Copernicus EFFIS / Emergency Management Service, and Proteção Civil (via Fogos.pt). Weather data from Open-Meteo. Fire-spread model based on published wildfire research by Anderson (1983) and Alexander (1985). This app is for informational purposes only and should not be the sole source for emergency decisions.
Universal app for iPhone, iPad and Mac.

However, Microsoft GDI only mandates the API between an application and the printer driver, not the protocol on the wire between the printer driver and the printer. firefox-addons:2671317.name: checkVT - Browser Security
firefox-addons:2671317.summary: checkVT sends the selected URL through a parsing process, then to VirusTotal to check if it has been analyzed for malware.
firefox-addons:2671317.description:
checkVT (check VirusTotal) is an open source project developed by Emyll Almonte for an independent research class supervised by Dr. Vaibhav Anu (Assistant Professor, Department of Computer Science), Montclair State University.
checkVT is a simple web browser extension that takes a selected URL via context-menu and submits it directly to be checked against all engines on VirusTotal with an added feature. VirusTotal is a free service that uses over 70 antivirus scanners and URL/domain blacklisting services to analyze suspicious files and URLs to detect types of malware. The feature checkVT incorporates is a process that tries to find the effective URL (redirect) if it exists on the URL that was submitted, and sends that URL to VirusTotal instead of the URL that was selected. This extra step helps users see the VirusTotal results for the URL/domain that they would have ended up at, as opposed to the original link they clicked on. URL redirection is a major phishing method that attackers use to masquerade as legitimate websites.
For more info and to see the open source code, please visit the GitHub repo: https://github.com/ealmonte32/checkVT

No clicks. No noise. Just smarter shopping when it matters.
✨ NEW: Hover any image, find the product

• Automatic price check on every product page — compares the store's price against typical market rates and flags inflated listings before you check out.
• Scam-store detection — analyzes the domain, TLD and product category for the signals that usually point to low-quality dropshipping or shady resellers.

Enhance your language learning or browsing experience with features like text-to-speech, reverse translation, typing translations in a popup, and easy copying of translations to the clipboard.
Whether you're reading foreign language websites or communicating across languages, It makes translation effortless and interactive. Customize the extension's options to fit your needs, enabling features like text-to-speech for listening to translations or reverse translating from your native language. Available for Firefox, Mouse Hover Translate is a handy tool for students, travelers, and language enthusiasts alike.

firefox-addons:2868448.description:

firefox-addons:2969912.name: Price Tracker
firefox-addons:2969912.summary: Get notified when a product price drops, changes or reaches your target price. Detects prices automatically on Amazon, Shopify, WooCommerce and most shops, keeps a price history, and works on Firefox for Android. No account, no tracking.
firefox-addons:2969912.description:
Price Tracker watches product prices in the background and sends you a
Firefox notification when a price changes.
Features:
• One-click tracking — open the popup on a product page; the price and its
 currency are detected automatically
• Works with Amazon, Target, Newegg, MediaMarkt, Shopify, WooCommerce,
 Magento, PrestaShop and any shop using standard product markup (JSON-LD,
 Open Graph, Schema.org microdata)
• Manual price picker for shops the detector doesn't cover, with a live
 preview
• Price alerts — set a target price on any product and get notified only
 when the price drops to it, rises above a limit you set, or either
• No false alarms: a new price is only reported after a second check
 confirms it
• Notify on every change or only on price drops
• Dashboard with price history charts, lowest/highest price, search and
 sorting
• Checks every 15 minutes to 24 hours (default: hourly)
• Export/import a backup of your tracked items
Opening Price Tracker:
• Desktop — click the Price Tracker icon in the toolbar.
• Firefox for Android — open a web page, tap ⋮ → Extensions → Price
 Tracker. The expand icon in the popup opens the full dashboard. To get
 price notifications on Android, allow notifications for Firefox in
 Android's settings.
Privacy: no accounts, no remote servers, no analytics. All data stays in
your browser's local storage. Prices are checked by loading the product
pages you chose to track, the same way your browser does when you visit
them.

firefox-addons:3067803.name: Party Tools for Roll20
firefox-addons:3067803.summary: A shared loot inventory for Dungeons and Dragons 5e and 5.5e games on Roll20: bags, coins and a full who-took-what log that everyone at the table can see and edit. It is kept inside your own campaign, so there is no server and no account to create.
firefox-addons:3067803.description:
A shared loot bag for your D&D group on Roll20, for both 5e and 5.5e.
Everyone at the table sees the same inventory. Drop items in, take them out,
split the coins, and it updates for everyone else within a second or two.
All of it lives in your own Roll20 campaign, stored as journal handouts.
There is no server involved, no account to create, and I never see any of it.
WHAT YOU NEED
A D&D game on Roll20's Jumpgate engine. If your game is still on Roll20's
older Legacy engine, the panel will not start, and it will tell you that is
why.
Both rulesets are supported, but not identically. Dragging items in reads
Roll20's D&D 5e compendium, which covers the 2014 rules (5e) and the 2024
rules (5.5e) alike. Sending an item onto a character sheet needs Roll20's
D&D 2024 sheet specifically; on the 2014 sheet, or any other sheet, the item
is recorded as assigned to that character instead of being written onto it.
Bags, coins, splitting and the log work whatever sheet you use.
WHAT IT DOES
Bags of loot the whole party can see and edit. The DM creates the bags,
everyone fills them.
Drag an item from the Roll20 compendium onto a bag and its name,
description, weight, cost and rarity come with it. You can also type in your
own items for anything homebrew.
Every bag has a coin purse. Splitting coins shows you the maths before you
commit to it: what converts down, what is left over, and who gets what. Each
share is held against a character until they take it.
Claim an item onto your character sheet, and move it back into a bag later.
A weapon stays a weapon, keeping its attack and damage.
Every change is recorded against a name and a time, so there is always an
answer to who took the rope.
You can search across every bag, sort within one, and rename them.
IF YOU ARE THE DM
You can make a bag hidden. Roll20's own servers withhold its contents from
players, so it is genuinely hidden and not just tucked out of sight in the
interface.
You can also disguise an item, so players see a written description instead
of its real name until you choose to reveal it. Anything you do in secret
goes to a separate log only you can read.
PRIVACY
Party Tools only runs on Roll20 game pages, so it cannot see anything else
you do in your browser. There is no analytics and nothing is sent to me.
Full policy:
 https://github.com/drsmith18/roll20-inventory-quest-tracker/blob/main/PRIVACY.md 
It is free and it is staying free. There is a Ko-fi link in the panel if it
earns its keep at your table.

firefox-addons:3043796.name: Youtube Theme Engine
firefox-addons:3043796.summary: A fully-local and powerful theme, layout, media, focus, and accessibility engine for YouTube and YouTube Music.
firefox-addons:3043796.description:
Youtube Theme Engine allows you to tweak almost every aspect of the YouTube UI including colors, buttons, text, media, and more. 
24 built-in dark, light, and high-contrast themes
18-channel custom palette editor with live color preview
Contrast checker for readable text
Automatic switching by system theme or a daily schedule
Different themes per page (Home, Watch, Shorts, Search, Music, and more)
Share and import palettes with theme codes
Layout & Typography
18 fonts plus text size, line height, and weight
Content width, video grid columns and spacing, sidebar width
Stacked Watch layout with related videos below the player
Rounded thumbnails, buttons, and panels, five avatar shapes
Custom scrollbar colors and width
Media & Player
Change thumbnail and video brightness, contrast, saturation, grayscale, opacity, etc.
Themed progress bar with adjustable thickness
Rounded player corners, theater width, cinema glow
Hide endscreens, watermarks, info cards, and annotations
Focus (40 toggles)
Zen mode for distraction-free watching
Hide Shorts, Playables, comments, related videos, live chat, home feed
Hide ads surfaces, merch shelves, and members-only cards
Hide view counts, upload dates, likes, badges, and thumbnail overlays
Hide completed or live videos, community posts, mixes, and playlists

apple-macos:6791101460.name: Formline: Workout & Food Log
apple-macos:6791101460.description:
Formline is a strength training and nutrition app for iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple Watch. It lines up your next workout, keeps each set clear, and tracks what you eat against your targets. Use it for training, for nutrition, or for both.
LOG WORKOUTS CURATED BY FORMLINE
• Get a program matched to your goal, experience, and the days you can train
• Choose from six built-in programs, or build your own with straight sets and alternating blocks
• Work one set at a time, with the movement, the load, the reps, and what you did last time
• See why each weight is suggested, and open any lift for its history
• Follow rest and progress on the Lock Screen and on Apple Watch
• Double tap on Apple Watch to save a set
• See your next workout in a widget, on the watch face, and in the Smart Stack
• Start any of your workouts from Siri or Shortcuts
• Swap an exercise or skip its remaining sets when the day changes
• Plan your week: move a workout to another day, change it, or make it a rest day, and undo any change
• Leave a note on a movement, like a seat height, and see it on the set screen next time
HIT YOUR MACROS
• Track calories, protein, carbs, and fat against daily targets set for your goal
• Search the food catalog or scan a barcode
• Add a food the catalog doesn’t have, from the label, per 100 g or per serving
• Put recipes together from your foods, and log them by the serving or by the gram
• Suggest a correction when a catalog food looks wrong
• Star your favorites so they come first in search
• Count water, on your iPhone, from Apple Watch, Siri, or Control Center, and see your day in Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Log the same meal again in one tap
• Pregnant? Add your week, and your targets follow it
KEEP YOUR STREAK
• A food streak counts the days you log, and a training streak counts the weeks you hit your target
• One spare flame a month covers a day or a week you missed
• Your streaks, workouts, and food log are saved in your iCloud, on every device you use
COMPETE WITH FRIENDS
• Start a private season and invite your friends
• A season can count workouts, the days you log food or hit your targets, or both
• Only display names, weekly points, and streak lengths are shared. Exercises, weights, foods, body data, and Health records are not.
SEE YOUR PROGRESS
• Readiness each morning, from the sleep and heart readings in Apple Health
• Training history, and a page for every lift
• Completed workouts, and the food and water you log, saved to Apple Health, if you allow it
• Your weight from Apple Health, and how it moved in 30 days
• Every lift shows how it moved in the last 30 days
ON IPHONE, IPAD, MAC, AND APPLE WATCH
• One membership covers every device
• iPad and Mac have a layout made for the bigger screen
PRIVACY
Your workouts, meals, and Health data stay on your devices and with Apple. None of it is sent to us. A food search sends only the search term or the barcode. A correction you suggest sends only that food and your values for it.
ONE MEMBERSHIP
Choose monthly, three-month, six-month, or yearly billing. Every option unlocks the full app. New members pay $0.99 for their first month. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in your Apple Account settings.
Privacy Policy: https://formline.elbantli.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

apple-macos:1508858488.name: Art Puzzles
apple-macos:1508858488.description:
Can you recreate these beautiful pieces of art? Like a jigsaw puzzle but each piece is a section of the artwork (by shade or subject) which needs to be put back into the right place. 154 art puzzles available to play immediately!
EASY TO LEARN
Simple drag and drop interface that works for adults and children. A simple tutorial on "How To Play" is included. Puzzles in each pack start easy and get harder the more you do.
HARD TO MASTER
Puzzles range from easy (solve in minutes) through to very hard (an hour or more). But don't worry, your placed pieces are automatically saved so you can do the puzzle over several sessions. You can also turn on and off useful guides like outlines or a ghost image depending on how hard you want it to be. And if some pieces are too small, just turn on the Auto-Zoom feature.
Can you earn all the Game Center achievements?
EDUCATIONAL
As you concentrate on each piece in the puzzle you see details of the artwork that aren't immediately obvious when looking at the completed piece. See the artwork as the original artist did - an element at a time. Once a puzzle is completed you can explore a zoomed in version to see all the detail.
PEACEFUL
An uncluttered puzzle solving space lets you be in the moment as you work your way through the puzzle at your own pace.
BEAUTIFUL
Work with some of the most beautiful and intriguing artworks from around the world and across the centuries.
HELPFUL
Some of the puzzles are hard. If you get stuck, use the Shuffle button to get new pieces, the Auto Fill feature to put those difficult pieces into their correct places or a Ghost image to help you find the right place.
CONNECTED
Works on your iPads and Macs. In-App purchases of puzzle packs are shared between your devices and you can easily enable synching up Puzzle completion progress between them. Start of one device and finish it on another.

apple-itunes:808183456.name: Anees Books - مكتبة أنيس
apple-itunes:808183456.description:
تطبيق «مكتبة أنيس» :
١- متجر الكتروني يحتوي على الآف الكتب الرقمية في مختلف المواضيع، مع إمكانية شراء الكتب ومطالعتها بسهولة
٢- يتوفر فيه الكثير من الكتب المجانية 
٣ - دار نشر المنتجات الفكرية والعلمية، مما يتيح للناشرين والمؤلفين إمكانية نشر وتسويق كتبهم الرقمية بطريقة سريعة.
٤- قراءة الكتب الرقمية بإمكانيات:( مشاهدة فهرس الكتاب, وضع علامات مرجعية متعددة, تدوين ملاحظة وكتابة تعليق, تظليل نصوص الكلمات أو الجمل, تغيير حجم نصّ الكتاب )
٥- سهولة استخدام التطبيق 
٦- تقنية تشفير عالية الآمان لحماية الكتب
٧- تصميم عصري لواجهة التطبيق يمتاز بالبساطة والفخامة
٨- عمليات آمنة في الشراء والتحميل بإستخدام حساب متجر ابل 
المتجر:
«متجر أنيس » يحتوي على الآف الكتب الرقمية في مختلف المواضيع، مع إمكانية شراء الكتاب أو تحميله مباشرة (إذا كان مجاناً)
أهم ما يتميز به المتجر:
- تبويب الكتب حسب المواضيع مثل: ( العلوم القرآنية، العقائد، الحديث، الفقه، الأخلاق، الفلسفة، التراجم، التاريخ، اللغة، الطب... إلى آخره)
-عرض قائمة بأسماء المؤلفين مرتبة أبجدياً مع إمكانية البحث في أسمائهم
- عرض الكتب المميزة : "قائمة الكتب الأكثر تحميلاً" و "قائمة الكتب الأعلى تقييماً"
- إمكانية استرجاع الكتب المشتراة أو ما تم تحميله
- محرك بحث متطور ( نصي) أو ( موضوعي) 
- توفر نبذة في تعريف كل كتاب وتفاصيل هويته: (المؤلف، الناشر، عدد الصفحات وغيره)ء
-إمكانية كتابة رأي حول الكتاب ومشاهدة آراء الأعضاء
- خاصية تقييم الكتب ومشاهدة تقييمات الأعضاء
- إمكانية مشاركة صديق عبر البريد الإلكتروني ودعوته للاطلاع على الكتاب
المكتبة:
هي واجهة البرنامج الرئيسية ومكتبة المستخدم الشخصية، وتحتوي على الكتب المشتراة أو المحملة من المتجر
من خصائص المكتبة:
- تغيير اللغة : " العربية " - " الإنجليزية "
- تغيير لون واجهة تصميم المكتبة بين: "رخامي " و " خشبي "
- إمكانية البحث في عناوين ومؤلفي الكتب المعروضة في المكتبة
- يمكن للمستخدم تغيير ترتيب عرض الكتب في رفوف المكتبة بسحب الكتاب
- إمكانية تصنيف كتب المكتبة من قبل المستخدم وتبويبها ضمن مجموعات خاصة به
- تغيير حالة عرض قائمة الكتب حسب ترتيب: "رف الكتب" أو "العناوين" أو "المؤلفين" أو "المواضيع"
قارئ الكتاب:
- إمكانية تصفح الكتاب بسهولة وذلك بالنقر على جانبي الكتاب
- دعم محاذاة النص (من اليمين إلى اليسار)، ودعم ترقيم الصفحات بالعربية
- عرض النصوص المحركة والملونة وبتنسيقات وأحجام مختلفة
- مشاهدة فهرس الكتاب والانتقال المباشر إلى الفصل أو العنوان المختار
- وضع علامات مرجعية متعددة في صفحات الكتاب للرجوع إليها لاحقاً
- تدوين ملاحظة وكتابة تعليق على أية كلمة أو فقرة من الكتاب
- إمكانية تظليل النصوص - سواء جملة كانت أم كلمة - في الكتاب وتلوينه بلون معين
- مراجعة قائمة العلامات التي تم تسجيلها في الكتاب (العلامات المرجعية، التظليل والملاحظات)
- البحث عن كلمة أو عبارة في أي مكان من الكتاب وعرض نتائج البحث، مع إمكانية الانتقال المباشر
- البحث عن الكلمة أو العبارة من الكتاب في "جوجل" أو موقع "ويكيبيديا" مباشرة
- تحديد جزء من نص الكتاب ونسخه إلى حافظة الجهاز
- تغيير حجم نص الكتاب تكبيراً أو تصغيراً
- تغيير لون خلفية صفحات الكتاب من الأبيض إلى خلفية خافتة لسهولة القراءة
- إمكانية تنظيم سطوع الشاشة مباشرة من التطبيق لاختيار الإضاءة الملائمة لقراءة الكتاب
 - سهولة التصفح السريع في الكتاب وذلك بسحب مؤشر الصفحة الموجود في الأسفل

apple-macos:989923828.name: Pray Watch
apple-macos:989923828.description:
Prayer times, beautifully simple. Pray Watch shows the day's prayers in an elegant, modern design inspired by Apple's own apps, built around its signature green prayer ring.
100% private. Always free. No ads, ever. No account, no tracking.
We use Pray Watch every day ourselves, so we've made it quick, calm and easy, on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Mac.
NEW IN 28.1
• Play the full adhan from the ring or a notification's Adhan button, with Lock Screen controls
• Wake-up alarms before Fajr for sahoor and before sunrise for Fajr
• Live Activities: the next prayer counts down on the Lock Screen, in the Dynamic Island and in CarPlay
• Controls for Control Center, the Lock Screen and the Action button
• A native Mac app, with the countdown in your menu bar and the full adhan at prayer time
• An iMessage app to meet around a prayer, pray together or share today's times
• Designed for iPad and iPhone Duo, with two columns when there's room
• A redesigned Apple Watch app and icons that match your theme
PRAYER TIMES
• Set up automatically for any city in the world, and your times follow you as you travel
• Over 20 calculation methods, or your own custom angles
• Fine-tune any prayer to match your masjid's timetable
• Pick a city on one device and your other devices follow, through iCloud
• Midnight and the last third of the night, to plan tahajjud and qiyam
• A monthly calendar with the full timetable, to print or share as a PDF
• The Hijri date on the main screen, widgets and complications, plus upcoming Islamic holidays
ADHAN AND REMINDERS
• A large collection of beautiful adhans from around the world, and gentle tones for more discreet alerts
• Pre-adhan reminders, to catch the current prayer or prepare for the next
• Iqama times and reminders, so you can join the congregation
• Duha reminders
• Play the full adhan, with the duaa after it and the takbeerat on Eid
• Wake-up alarms before Fajr and sunrise, with snooze (iOS 26.1 and later)
• Snooze any alert and be reminded later
• Long-press a notification to see the Qibla and the countdown without opening the app
APPLE WATCH
• The prayer ring on your wrist, with the day's prayers around it
• Complications for every face, and the Smart Stack at the right time
• Settings stay in sync with your iPhone through iCloud
WIDGETS, CONTROLS AND LIVE ACTIVITIES
• Home Screen, Lock Screen and desktop widgets
• Controls in Control Center, on the Lock Screen and the Action button: the next prayer, the current prayer's adhan, mute the next prayer, and the Qibla (iOS 18 and later)
• Live Activities on the Lock Screen, in the Dynamic Island and in CarPlay, through to the iqama, before every prayer or only in the car (iOS 26 and later)
QIBLA AND MORE
• A simple Qibla compass with haptic feedback on iPhone and Apple Watch, and a Qibla map on Mac
• Masjid Locator finds the nearest masjid
• Siri and Shortcuts in English, Arabic and Turkish: ask for a prayer or its iqama, the time left or the Hijri date, mute a prayer, play the adhan, or set iqama times from a shortcut
MAKE IT YOURS
• Color themes for the app, widgets, complications and even the app icon
• Light, dark or automatic appearance
• 24-hour time
• English, Arabic and Turkish
• Accessibility support, including VoiceOver and Dynamic Type
Light on battery and data, built on the latest Apple technologies.

apple-macos:6757938820.description:
Tesseract — private messaging that leaves no trail.
No accounts. No phone numbers. No cloud history. Add a friend with a one-time invite code, pick an emoji for each other, and start talking. Every message is end-to-end encrypted; the relay only ever sees opaque bytes.
Your identity lives in this device's secure keychain. Reinstall the app and it's gone — nothing is recoverable, from us or anyone else.
What you get for free
• End-to-end encrypted 1:1 chat (X25519 + AES-256-GCM)
• Emoji-based contacts instead of names or numbers
• Invite codes that expire in 24 hours or on first use
• Notification Disguise — 10 preset alt-icons and lock-screen texts
• App Lock with PIN + optional silent Duress PIN
• Minimalist brutalist interface built for speed
Unlock TESSERACT PLUS for the full suite
• TOR ROUTING — every request tunneled through Tor; the relay sees an exit node, never you
• GHOST TEXT — messages your eye reads but cameras average away
• PIXEL SHATTER — text realigns only at the owner's viewing angle
• CUSTOM TIMER — self-destructing messages that vanish from both phones
• PHOTOS · VIDEOS · GIFS — end-to-end encrypted media
• 30-DAY MAILBOX — missed messages held longer
Tesseract does not have a "delete for everyone" button because there is nothing to delete. Messages don't live on a server. The relay is a dumb pipe.
